projects.name: Bendigo Hospital Redevelopment
projects.description: The largest health infrastructure investment in Bendigo's history, delivering new surgical, emergency and inpatient facilities. Permanently expands the region's healthcare employment base and attracts skilled health professionals.

projects.name: La Trobe University Campus Expansion
projects.description: Ongoing investment in research and teaching facilities across the Bendigo campus, growing the student population and supporting the knowledge economy transition of the regional workforce.

projects.name: Regional Rail Revival — Bendigo Line
projects.description: Victorian Government investment in regional rail uplift statewide, including improved service frequency and infrastructure upgrades on the Bendigo line — directly supporting Melbourne connectivity.

risks.title: Economic concentration risk
risks.description: Healthcare and education are the dominant employers. A reduction in Federal or State funding to these sectors could soften local employment and rental demand, though both institutions have long-term infrastructure commitments that provide significant forward visibility.

risks.title: Melbourne commute viability
risks.description: At approximately 2 hours, the Bendigo–Melbourne commute is at the outer limit for daily travel. Any shift toward mandatory return-to-office could reduce lifestyle migrant demand, though local tenant demand is largely employment-driven rather than commuter-driven.

risks.title: Price ceiling relative to Melbourne
risks.description: Bendigo's price growth is partly constrained by local income levels. Unlike markets with direct Melbourne pricing arbitrage, growth here is driven by local wage growth and serviceability rather than capital city proximity repricing.
